content:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime.streams.eu: p99 latency > 3s for 5m; SLO breach detected. p95 1.2s, p99 3.8s, error rate 0.2%. Trigger: latency-detector. Paging @oncall-mira. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/streams/eu/latency
oncall-mira: I'm on it. handover -> Mira (oncall). Starting quick checks. @eng-sre please standby.
alex-komar: Joining. quick Qs: traffic spiky or steady? any deploys to eu-stream cluster in last hour?
incident-bot: Deploys: none in last 2h. Traffic: +12% over baseline last 10m. Autoscale: nodes at 78% GPU util. KV-cache evictions increased.
sam-evans: KV evictions -> could be kvcache size thrash. I didn't touch EU. I'll check kvcache metrics + redis.
oncall-mira: Quick checklist: 1) confirm p99 per-model 2) check kvcache evictions 3) check GPU queue / runtime queueing 4) look at model-variant fallbacks 5) customer impact. Triage doc: https://go.redwood/incidents/template
alex-komar: p99 dominated by streaming endpoints. model=redwood-medium-v1 shows tail ~6s for seqs >1024 tokens. p95 for same model ~1.1s. Traces show waiting on disk reads for mmaped weights on eu-03 node.
sam-evans: Confirming redis kvcache evictions spike: evictions/sec 420 -> memory pressure on eu-cache-1. Redis logs show intermittent RDB save failures.
oncall-mira: @karen-csm can you pull customer impact? any prod tickets reported?
karen-csm: Got 2 support tickets from EU customers: playback delays and partial stream retries. No data exposure. CS is messaging affected tenants now.
alex-komar: Mitigation ideas: 1) pin hot models to eu-04 with warmed mmap 2) reduce max sequence length to 768 for streaming previews 3) route some traffic to eu-secondary region (latency tradeoff). Thoughts?
sam-evans: I can patch redis to reduce evictions (volatile-lru) and bump maxmemory. Should reduce thrash in ~2m.
oncall-mira: Do it. @sam-evans proceed. Alex prepare targeted model pin rollback to eu-04. If p99 >3s after 10m -> failover to eu-secondary.
sam-evans: Patching redis now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra exec eu-cache-1 -- redis-cli config set maxmemory 12gb
redis-cli config set maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
```
Applying... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Action log: redis config change applied by sam-evans at 5432109902
alex-komar: Started model pin rollout to eu-04 canary 5% -> 50% warmed mmap. Command:
```sh
redwoodctl rollout --model redwood-medium-v1 --target eu-04 --canary 0.05
```
oncall-mira: Monitoring p95/p99 on dashboard. Early signal: p99 dropped 3.8s -> 2.1s after redis patch. p95 stable. Watching for stabilization.
karen-csm: Notifying the two affected customers with ETA ~15m for full recovery. Marking incident severity SEV3 (partial degradation).
alex-komar: If still unstable after 15m, prep transparent routing to eu-secondary. I'll have rollback steps ready.
oncall-mira: Good work team. Keep this channel updated. Escalate to SRE lead if not resolved in 30m. :thumbsup:
